purpose: Remaining literal-message candidates for manual classification. Includes technical errors and constants; not a test-cell count or proof of a product defect.

Native recording and playback failures are ordinary Errors. The voice interaction boundary maps them to cataloged failure state rather than displaying these exception messages. This classification does not certify microphone-permission UX or physical audio acceptance.

OnboardingScreen delegates typed partial-success failures and other errors to onboardingError; the presentation catalog supplies both recovery context and guidance. Application messages are not rendered directly.

Local batch validation errors are ordinary Error values. NotificationInbox supplies cataloged mark-all recovery; these diagnostics do not define rendered notification labels.

reviewedClassifications.reason: Invalid request and validation failed are diagnostic comparisons. Only errors explicitly marked safeForUser can surface server-provided messages; other failures use caller fallback.

strings: Conversation session is no longer active.
reviewedClassifications.reason: Disposed-session mutation attempts throw AbortError. Workflow/case catches select catalog messages only while the session is active; run setup similarly selects typed failure/fallback guidance.

strings: Asset ID is required.

strings: Add-here parent must be a container or location.
